consumers.reason: reconcile_product_fixtures reads product_fixtures, explicit team crosswalks and admitted mappings. Observation insertion does not create these inputs.
admitted_identity_at reads R2 admissions/corrections. Native references, resolution_version null and capability identity descriptions are not admission proofs.

verify_source_identifier requires existing mappings plus checksum-verified provider-specific retained identity proof and append-only admission. It does not automatically map observations; the new provider namespaces are not accepted by the legacy verifier.
product_eligible_history_at uses eligible product_match_history_decisions with both decision and source knowledge cutoffs. It does not read V2 artifacts.

_batch_history reads product_eligible_history_at, excludes target identities, enforces prior kickoff/known_at. _prepare_forecasts reads verified product fixtures. Before/after nonempty history and published forecast values are equal.
FixtureFeatureSnapshotV1 validates a sealed ForecastInputSnapshot of qualified HistoricalMatch inputs; there is no artifact registry query or native observation coercion.
PointInTimeMatchDatasetProvider verifies exact published dataset/source identity before reading dataset_match_facts and kickoff claims. New raw source registration cannot substitute for that pair.

load_season and _read_corpus_match consume exact hashed frozen corpus/target manifests and normalized files. They have no observation/capability database reader. No protected evaluation was executed; dataset admission and existing protocol boundary tests were run.
Registry reads exact registration hash and cutoff; load_registered_champion validates the pinned champion. Observation/capability writes neither register nor activate/promote a model.
_SOURCE reads product_performance_forecasts and exact product_forecasts, not native observation artifacts.
_snapshot uses public_performance_source and fixed public source functions; those consume qualified product state. No native artifact promotion exists.
Existing queries read product_serving_fixtures and product_forecasts; migration route remains gated. No observation table joins.

consumers.consumer: Admin counts and provider depth audit
consumers.reason: Read-only inventory/field audit explicitly exposes registered native facts and capability counts; it does not qualify them. Go admin_operation_queries and market readiness diagnostics also expose counts/scopes.

resource_observation_ids_at returns all facts known by cutoff, not a canonical winner. Earlier cutoffs exclude later facts; an explicit football_cutoff excludes null/simultaneous/future event_time. All affected operating artifacts have event_time null.
Partial/SUPPORTED decisions can permit exact-version exact-native-scope acquisition. That is intentional access planning, not canonical/model eligibility. No wildcard/fallback to other scopes.
AuthorityRegistry uses separate explicit effective/knowledge-scoped decisions. Operating authority registry is empty; capability presence cannot supply authority.
Native source availability is visible, but canonical coverage, semantics, frozen evaluation and model publication remain independent. Tests assert all sample markets cannot grant publication.

verify_parity rechecks retained hashed comparison evidence and current diagnostics; overall_status requires every required runtime scope complete with all other checks. Counts alone cannot replace a comparison universe.
qualify_stage refuses SWITCH_STAGE pending complete production parity, upstream cutover, qualified runtime binding and separate owner acceptance. No route was changed.

visibility_limit: Admin/native diagnostics and exact scoped acquisition planning can observe or act on access metadata. Visibility does not grant canonical, feature, evaluation, model or cutover eligibility. development_only text was not used as an enforcement premise.

regressions.control: Fresh migrated disposable DB; existing admitted CSV history, existing canonical fixtures, nonempty published forecast, refreshed materialized fixture read model. Native source sample retained through current manifest/backfill/normalization/work owners.
assertions: Nonempty eligible history identical before and after at original and later cutoffs
Earlier native knowledge empty; later diagnostic visibility allowed; unknown event_time excluded from football history
Existing complete forecast rows and prepared inputs unchanged
Exact published dataset/source pair still required for training/evaluation data
Actual read-only parity remains non-PASS and SWITCH_STAGE rejects
Exact processing version/scope required for acquisition; authority empty and publication not granted
Serving projections, datasets, read reports and post-match registry unchanged

verification.initial_test_setup_failures: Corrected test import, transaction boundaries, materialized view initialization and mixed history seed order; no production behavior was changed to pass tests.

disposition: Existing qualification owners provide separation. Preserve registrations without rewriting or adding a duplicate admission/status schema.
